name: 7 Wonders
summary: Card-drafting civilization building game where players develop cities and wonders over three ages.
rules_text: Each player gets a Wonder board and starts with 3 coins. Play over 3 Ages, each with its own shuffled deck filtered by player count. At start of Age, deal 7 cards to each player. Each Age lasts 6 turns: all players simultaneously choose one card from hand and then either build it paying its resource cost or chain, build a Wonder stage, or discard for 3 coins. Resources are produced by your board and built brown/gray/yellow cards. Missing resources can be bought from immediate left/right neighbor for 2 coins each (1 with discount), purchase does not deplete owner. Card colors: brown/gray resources, blue points, green science sets, yellow commerce, red military, purple guilds in Age III. After choosing, pass remaining hand left in Ages I and III, right in Age II. After 6 turns the last card is discarded. Resolve military: each player compares red shields with each neighbor, gaining +1/+3/+5 VP for wins in Age I/II/III or -1 for loss. After Age III, score: military tokens, coins divided by 3, Wonder stages, blue cards, yellow, purple guilds, and green science (sets squared plus 7 per trio). Most points wins.
rating_reason: Card drafting simultaneous choice, no spatial board needed
